name: io.github.martynyuu.resonite-glb-export
description: One-click export of a Unity (VRChat) avatar to a single .glb for native drag-and-drop import into Resonite. Optionally bakes Modular Avatar / NDMF non-destructively first (Merge-Armature accessories keep correct weights) and works around glTFast's null-bone export crash. No Resonite mod, no bridge, no headless engine — just a .glb that Resonite's own importer loads (meshes, skeleton, blendshapes/morphs, embedded textures).
